methods.formula: 10-year Monte Carlo: revenue growth switches between high / steady / decline regimes by a Markov chain; margin drifts by regime; value = Σ discounted FCFF − SBC + terminal, per share
assumptions: its own history + the panel prior (markov.json)
methods.fit: It has a DCF and enough quarters of revenue history to estimate how often its growth switches regime.

methods.formula: FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − ΔWC;  EV = Σ FCFF/(1+WACC)^t + TV/(1+WACC)^5;  TV = NOPAT₆ × (1 − g ÷ ROIC) ÷ (WACC − g);  value = (EV − debt + cash − claims) ÷ shares
steps: growth by year -5%, -3%, -2%, -0%, 1%; EBIT margin 3.9%; D&A 5.0% of revenue; capex 4.9% of revenue; ΔWC 10% of each revenue increase
